plan.title: SRC-E2E-008 Service PR Split Award to PO

steps.note: Enable split awarding across vendors.
Enable RFX project creation from the PR flow.
Allow vendors to be added during event creation.
Provide the mandatory event title.

args.goal: add one required T&C clause to the event and save it, leaving the create screen ready for scheduling

steps.note: Add the required terms clause, which has no dedicated catalog step.
Commit the 30-minute event duration; the catalog cannot set the separate evaluation duration.
Invite two QA vendors without inventing supplier names.
Publish the single-stage RFQ.
Verify that publication reached a real project page.
Submit the first vendor's portal quote at 100.
Verify the first vendor's quote was submitted.
Submit the second vendor's portal quote at 90.
Verify the second vendor's quote was submitted.
Wait for bidding to end before ranking and awarding.
Open the buyer comparison grid after bidding closes.
Verify that the lower bid ranks first.
Enter the awarding flow.
Allocate six units of the service line to the lower-bidding second vendor.
Allocate the remaining four units to the first vendor.
Verify that the line is fully allocated across both vendors.
Create the proposal from the completed split allocation.
Submit the award proposal for approval.
Verify that the award proposal was created and submitted.
Complete the approved award and create the purchase orders.
Verify that the created purchase orders contain the two awarded service activities.
Return to the events list to verify the event entered history.
Open the History tab.
Verify that this plan's event appears in event history.
